authority: spec section 2 head families + prereg_evidence_heads_v1.json allowed_range bounds; NOT a preregistration and NOT a freeze
purpose: Declared smoke-tier numeric constants so the evidence path can be exercised END TO END on a non-evidence-bearing run. prereg_evidence_heads_v1.json still carries status 'unfrozen' for g_v, h_c, h_o, pi_miss and g_pos_sigma, with freeze_point 'before the first evidence-bearing job (B2)'; elgs.evidence_stack.load_evidence_constants REFUSES to build heads from the frozen prereg while any entry is unfrozen, and accepts this file ONLY when elgs_smoke_schedule is set. Nothing here may be cited as a fitted value: no calibration sequence has been read.
provenance_of_values: midpoints or defensible interior points of the allowed_range bounds the heads prereg already fixes; chosen WITHOUT looking at any DiVa-360 report distribution, so they carry no information from the data and cannot bias a later fit

g_v.family: beta(a,b) on [v_min, v_max], monotone-increasing constraint a >= 1
g_v.note: a in [1,8], b in [0.5,4] per the heads prereg allowed_range. CORRECTED: an earlier draft used b=2, which is NOT monotone increasing — beta(a,b) peaks interior at (a-1)/(a+b-2) whenever b > 1, so beta(4,2) rises to u=0.75 then falls. The prereg's monotone-increasing requirement needs b <= 1; b=1 gives density 4*u^3, strictly increasing on [0,1], so a higher reported visibility is never less likely under the visible head. Max density 4.0 at u=1, inside g_cap 6.0.

h_c.note: the heads prereg permits 'uniform or 8-bin histogram density'; uniform is the parameter-free member and the only one specifiable without reading calibration data

rho_note: alpha_u = n_cam^(-rho); prereg_observability_v1.json alpha_u.rho allowed_range [0.5, 1.0], status unfrozen. 0.75 is the midpoint.
sigma_world_note: one bridge-covariance sigma per world axis for the frozen 7-point sigma grid (prereg_observability sigma_points). No bridge covariance is estimated at smoke tier, so a small fixed world-space radius stands in; it is a smoke constant, not an estimate.
anchor_report_floor_note: elgs.bridges.find_anchor_intervals requires a preregistered floor on a plateau run's TOTAL capped visible-report count. No frozen prereg currently carries this constant; it MUST acquire one before B2. Flagged, not silently defaulted.
min_occupancy_cameras_note: matches prereg_m1_absence_diagnostic_v1.json frozen_constants.min_occupancy_cameras and the spec's own 'visible in >= 2 training cameras' seed rule
vis_threshold_note: the tracker's own cfg.vis_threshold, the SAME constant elgs-absence-diagnostic-result.md identifies as a per-point self-occlusion signal. It is used here ONLY to build anchor plateaus and d_u, never as an existence claim: the census's hard v>=0.5 association-to-existence mapping is NOT imported into the trainer.
unfrozen_items_still_outstanding: g_v (a, b) — MLE on calibration visible-report values
h_o — uniform, freeze with the others
pi_miss (vis/cens/out) — empirical miss rates per condition
alpha_u.rho — empirical variance inflation of per-camera report agreement
r_u mapping — frozen with the tracks artifact manifest (the artifact already declares one; it is consumed verbatim)
anchor_report_floor — has no prereg home at all
sigma_world / bridge covariance — no estimator specified
the bridge constructor family itself (smoke tier uses hold-left/linear/hold-right)
